name: Production Payment Gateway CrashLoop Post-Release
description: Deployment v2.4.12 introduced null pointer dereference in billingAddress, causing 65.4% HTTP 500 error rate on checkout payments

alert.summary: CRITICAL: payment-gateway-service HTTP 500 error rate jumped to 65.4% following deployment v2.4.12
alert.details: Crash loop and unhandled exceptions in POST /api/v1/payments/charge. Revenue impacting.

expectedDiagnosis.rootCauseAnalysis: Regression introduced in commit 7f8a9b2 (feat(checkout): optimize payment token validation pipeline). Missing optional chaining check when dereferencing 'billingAddress' in payload, throwing unhandled TypeError on all guest checkout transactions without saved profiles.

remediationPlan.rationale: Roll back Kubernetes deployment to previous stable image (v2.4.11) and revert commit 7f8a9b2 in git repository to restore payment processing availability immediately.

actions.command: node -e "console.log('ROLLOUT_UNDO: rolled back deployment to revision 2')"
actions.description: Rollback Kubernetes deployment to prior stable release (v2.4.11)
Revert breaking commit in git repository to maintain master branch health
Create hotfix release tag for version tracking

safetyReview.riskMitigationNotes: Rollout undo targets verified pre-release image tag v2.4.11 with 100% test pass record. Zero database schema migrations involved in commit 7f8a9b2, ensuring backwards-compatible rollback.
